## Why

Slicer 1.15.0 prints `Contract: relay v8` (../slicer/CHANGELOG.md:20). The bump changes only the outer session's hand-back handling and the orchestrator's last line (`waiting on: ROLE AGENT-ID`); the role prompts ork embeds are unchanged by it. ork's accepted set is {7} (`internal/roles/roles.go:58`, boundary.contract, record 67), so `ork doctor` and the engine's contract check refuse the current slicer. Record 67 says ork lists the versions it supports and refuses others; adding v8 means checking what the bump changed, which is done here. Owner 2026-10-23: file a slice to accept v7 and v8.
